title: cheilanthes sulphurea
intro: Cheilanthes sulphurea, commonly known as the Sulfur Spleenwort, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes sulphurea include its expectorant and cough-suppressant effects, which help to relieve congestion and soothe the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
